_note: Shipment & logistics facts. ONE source for the web page and the downloadable TRADE-COMPLIANCE.md (scripts/build_trade_compliance_md.py reads this file too). Every value is transcribed from the factory's own knowledge base (public/assets/data/faq.json) or from the terms already published on the contact and terms pages. Nothing here is a price: freight is quote-per-lane, the same rule as the unit price. Production lead times are NOT here — they are derived from lib/products.json so they cannot drift.

channels.label: Sea freight — FOB Guangzhou / Shenzhen
channels.transit: 25–35 days to Europe and the US West Coast; 35–45 days to the US East Coast
channels.note: The default lane for bulk palletised orders. Cheapest per unit, slowest to arrive.

channels.label: Sea freight — DDP to your warehouse
channels.note: We handle export customs, ocean freight, import clearance and the final mile. Duty and tax are inside the quote.

channels.label: Air freight
channels.note: For launches and restocks where the shelf date matters more than the freight bill.

channels.label: Express courier — DHL / FedEx / UPS
channels.note: Samples and urgent top-ups. Freight is paid by the buyer.

incoterms.note: Risk transfers at the named port of loading. Any other term is quoted on request.

tracking.document: Bill of lading (B/L) for sea, air waybill (AWB) for air and courier
tracking.flow: 35% prepaid by the buyer when the order is placed → production completed → the logistics order number is issued and confirmed with the buyer → the balance is collected → the goods ship.
tracking.issuance: Issued when production is complete, and confirmed with the buyer before the balance is settled — so you have the tracking number before the goods move. On sea the B/L is the title document; on air and courier it is the AWB or courier tracking number.
tracking.samples: Samples are dispatched with a courier tracking number within 48 hours.
tracking.howToUse: Sea: the B/L number is your container number and can be tracked through the forwarder. Air and courier: the AWB or courier number is trackable from the first scan.

documents: Bill of lading (B/L) or air waybill (AWB)

freight.basis: Quoted per lane against your destination, the volume and the Incoterms term, and shown separately from the product price so you can compare suppliers on the same basis.
freight.samples: Sample freight is paid by the buyer: USD 30–80 via DHL / FedEx / UPS depending on weight and destination.
freight.ddp: On a DDP lane the freight, import duty and tax are one quote — no separate customs invoice to settle.
